driver.behavior: A GTest listener arms a 120-second wall-time budget on each rank for every test case and disarms it when the case ends. The test-only watchdog uses a thread, condition variable and mutex, not a signal alarm. Application launchers register only their owned process group with the same mutex used for reaping; on deadline the watchdog kills that group and exits with failure, so surviving child pipe holders cannot hang CTest. It never targets the enclosing GoogleTest/MPI process group. Test discovery bypasses MPI and the watchdog, as before.
